title: HEEDS workflows and connector status
description: Explore HEEDS workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

HEEDS

HEEDS supports automated design-space exploration and multidisciplinary optimisation across engineering tools.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Connect design variables

Use the selected equations, data, parameters and units. In the intended HEEDS preview, connect design variables; the visible result is a reproducible model or calculation with declared inputs visible. Review dimensions, assumptions, data quality and numerical range before accepting or exporting it.

Run a search strategy

Start from the operating case, solver settings or experiment space. In the intended HEEDS preview, run a search strategy; the visible result is computed signals, candidates or numerical results linked to each parameter. Review stability, convergence, sensitivity and expected behaviour before accepting or exporting it.

Compare robust candidates

Begin with the checked plots, tables and requirement references. In the intended HEEDS preview, compare robust candidates; the visible result is a reviewable notebook, worksheet or result package. Review units, reproducibility, traceability and engineering interpretation before accepting or exporting it.
